title: Milano documents for vocabulary examples@1.5.0
description: Generated by generate_document_schema.py; authoring-time validation specialized to one vocabulary. The gate remains the source of truth.

on.description: Lifecycle bindings (contract 2.1): action lists bound to the appear and disappear signals.

watch.description: Watch bindings (contract 2.2): action lists bound to changes of declared state keys.

items.description: $repeat only: the array expression the template is instantiated over.

as.description: $repeat only: the name that binds each element inside the template; <as>_index binds its position.

key.description: $repeat only (contract 2.1): an expression identifying each instance; its rendering replaces the element index in the instance's reference.

condition.description: $if only (contract 2.1): the bool expression choosing the branch.

then.description: $if only (contract 2.1): the nodes materialized when the condition holds.

else.description: $if only (contract 2.1): the nodes materialized when it does not; absent materializes nothing.

subject.description: $switch only (contract 2.1): the enum expression choosing the branch.

cases.description: $switch only (contract 2.1): the nodes each enum member materializes.

default.description: $switch only (contract 2.1): the nodes every member without a case materializes.

value.description: A literal of the declared type, or an expression wrapper. An object carrying $expr must be exactly the single-key wrapper.
